title: Golden Crab Cakes with Paprika-Lemon Mayonnaise
summary: Sweet crab meat is bound lightly with egg, mayonnaise and herbs, pressed into panko-crusted cakes, fried until golden and briefly baked through, then served with a punchy paprika-lemon mayonnaise.

ingredients.item: cooked white crab meat (fresh or pasteurised), picked over for shell
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix the Crab Base
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, egg, lemon juice and zest, mustard powder, paprika, cayenne, salt and pepper together in a large bowl until smooth. Fold in the crab meat, spring onions, parsley and the 50g of panko with a spatula, working gently so some lumps of crab stay whole. Keeping larger pieces intact gives the cakes a chunkier, more satisfying texture rather than a smooth paste.

steps.title: Shape and Chill
steps.text: Divide the mixture into 8 portions and shape each into a cake about 7cm across and 2cm thick on a lined tray. Cover and chill for at least 30 minutes, up to 8 hours. As they rest, the crumbs soak up excess moisture and the fat firms up, which is what stops the cakes falling apart in the hot pan.

steps.title: Make the Sauce
steps.text: Stir together the mayonnaise, ketchup, lemon juice and paprika in a small bowl and chill until ready to serve. This gives the paprika a little time to mellow into the mayonnaise.

steps.title: Coat the Cakes
steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (fan 180°C), then tip the coating panko into a shallow dish and press each chilled cake into the crumbs on both sides and round the edge. An even, firm crumb coat is what gives the finished cake its crisp shell once fried.

steps.title: Fry Until Golden
steps.text: Heat 1.5 tbsp oil in the frying pan over medium heat and fry four cakes for 3 minutes per side, turning gently once with the fish slice, until deep golden all over. Move them to a baking tray and repeat with the remaining oil and cakes. Frying first builds the crisp, browned crust that baking alone wouldn't achieve.

steps.title: Finish in the Oven
steps.text: Bake all the cakes for 6-8 minutes until a probe inserted into the centre of a cake reads at least 71°C, since the mixture contains raw egg and needs this higher heat to be safe. Finishing in the oven cooks the centre through fully without burning the outside any further.

steps.title: Serve Warm
steps.text: Serve two cakes per person with the paprika-lemon mayonnaise and lemon wedges alongside. A squeeze of fresh lemon over the top lifts the richness of both the cake and the sauce.

tips: Chill the shaped cakes for at least 30 minutes before frying; skipping this step is the most common reason they break apart in the pan.
Fold the crab mixture gently rather than mashing it, so the cakes keep some texture instead of turning pasty.
Pick over the crab meat carefully for stray shell before mixing, as small pieces are easy to miss.
safety: Check the centre reaches at least 71°C in the oven, since the mixture contains raw egg and needs to be cooked through fully.
storage: Cool leftovers within 2 hours and refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 2 days. Reheat in a moderate oven until piping hot all the way through (74°C); a microwave can leave the coating soggy.
